agents.role: Runs the headway board: bunching and gaps on each line segment against the schedule, so a gap is flagged while it can still be fixed, not after riders complain.
Watches car and bus health across the rolling stock, and keeps the out-of-service list current against the dispatch board.
Watches platform and station crowd states where feeds exist, and flags crowd build toward unsafe density before it is a crush.
Keeps the verified incident record as it happens: suspensions, rescues, injury counts, and clearance, sealed at the end of each event.

The only agent in this pack that may post across worlds. Publishes service state and casualty summaries as counts to police, EMS, and civic worlds, and receives road and scene status that affects surface transit.

alerts.carries: The line id and the observed gap in minutes against the schedule. Local to the agency; dispatch acts on it.
The car or bus id, the fault class, and the line id. Local only.
The station id and the observed crowd state against safe-density thresholds. Local only; no images leave the system.
The line id, the suspension state, and the estimated delay in minutes. Local to the agency.
A summary only: incident id, casualty counts by severity, and service state. No rider or worker names.
A summary only: line ids, service states, and delay counts. No incident details, no crew names.

receives.carries: Road closures and perimeter state affecting surface bus and track-right access, summarized; no police record details.
Storm clearing status by sector affecting surface transit, as counts and states.
Water advisory state affecting street operations (main breaks flooding track beds), as states.

sends.carries: Incident id, casualty counts by severity, and service state at the scene. Counts only.
never_carries: images or video of the scene

sends.carries: Incident id, casualty counts by severity, and perimeter support needs. Counts only.
never_carries: images or video of the scene

sends.carries: Service status by line as states and delay counts, for mobility during storms and major events.

firstboot.label: Lines or divisions this installation serves
Crew roster: runs and the workers riding them this week
Headway gap threshold in minutes before a flag fires

bus_summary: Service states by line with delay counts
Casualty counts by severity at an incident
Crowd-state counts by station where feeds exist
local_only: Rider observation feeds and platform imagery
Worker names, crew rosters, and overtime records
Car and bus fault details and maintenance records
The full incident timeline before it is sealed and reviewed

summary: Transit operations pack: watches headways and gaps against the schedule, rolling stock health, platform crowd states where feeds exist, and keeps the verified incident record. Built around the operating crews: extra boards, overtime exposure, and the workers riding the runs are guarded as closely as the schedule. Service states and casualty counts cross to other worlds as summaries only; imagery and roster detail never leave the agency. SPEC ONLY: this is a pack definition, not a running transit system.

urgency.meaning: Platform overcrowd toward crush conditions and any casualty event. Preempts everything else on the bus.
Service suspensions, bad headway gaps, and casualty summaries during an incident.
Cars pulled from service and headway drift inside tolerance.
Sealed incident timelines and end-of-shift summaries.

inputs: the position feed for the fleet on this installation's lines
watchers.watches: Headways on every line segment this installation serves: bunching and gaps against the schedule, flagged while the gap can still be recovered.
Rolling stock health: fault codes, out-of-service state, and which equipment is available for the dispatch board.

inputs: station crowd feeds that stay on agency systems
watchers.watches: Platform and station crowd states: flagged against safe-density thresholds before they become crush conditions.
The verified incident record: suspensions, rescues, casualty counts, and clearance, kept in order and sealed at the end of each event.
